summary: Correctly exposes the existing skip_checks stealth option as a real --skip-checks CLI flag, gated on requires_system_checks, matching Django's actual merged fix for this ticket. No blocking problems; a few minor compatibility/robustness nits worth noting.

issues.description: Removing 'skip_checks' from base_stealth_options means call_command('cmd', skip_checks=True) on a command with requires_system_checks=False now raises TypeError (unknown option) instead of silently accepting it as before. The flag is a no-op for such commands anyway, so impact is small, but it is a subtle behavioral change for programmatic callers.

options['skip_checks'] (subscript) is slightly more fragile than the prior options.get('skip_checks'); it relies on short-circuit evaluation of self.requires_system_checks plus the parser always supplying the store_true default. A direct execute(**options) call with requires_system_checks=True but no skip_checks key would KeyError. Safe for all standard parser/call_command paths.
A new user-facing CLI option ideally warrants docs/ref/django-admin.txt and release-note updates; not present in the shown source diff (may be omitted like tests).
